runs.prompt: What changed in the latest iPhone compared with the previous model? Give three changes that matter and cite one hands-on review.
runs.answer:
The iPhone 18 Pro keeps the iPhone 17 Pro’s basic design, aluminum body, and screen sizes, but three changes matter:

- **Variable-aperture main camera** — the main lens now has a variable aperture. [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/986400/apple-iphone-18-pro-max-hands-on-impressions-september-2026-event)
- **New “pro” camera controls** — added controls give more options when taking photos. [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/986400/apple-iphone-18-pro-max-hands-on-impressions-september-2026-event)
- **Color-matched glass back** — the back glass now blends with the aluminum frame for a uniform look, replacing the two-tone appearance of the iPhone 17 Pro. [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/986400/apple-iphone-18-pro-max-hands-on-impressions-september-2026-event)

All three are from The Verge’s hands-on impressions at Apple’s September 2026 event.
